steps.what: Design control systems or algorithms for these purposes
Cover automotive energy management and emissions management
Cover increased operational safety or performance

tasks.design: The engineer designs control systems or algorithms for purposes such as automotive energy management, emissions management, or increased operational safety or performance. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. The design stays at full effort. The engineer signs safety-related choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer designs the control and judges the safety effect.
tasks.enabler_now: No generated algorithm replaces the design.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the control, including for safety, stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not sign a control whose safety effect they have not checked.
tasks.altitude: The control design stays the engineer's, including where safety or emissions are the purpose.

reach.task: Review the algorithm before it is released
reach.learn: Which purposes that colleague says are unmet.

evidence.claim: Designing these control systems or algorithms stays manual.
The engineer who signs a control that affects operational safety remains responsible for it.

assumptions: The work starts with a purpose for the control and ends when the engineer has designed it, or stops.
No new record is filed by a system. Upkeep is zero.
Calibration of the signed control on a vehicle is a different task.
unknowns: Which control purposes are safety-related on this vehicle.
research_questions: Which designs did the engineer refuse because the safety effect was unclear?

already_counted.description: Designing the control systems or algorithms is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the design adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every control is still designed by the engineer. High: the same design work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop or integrate control feature requirements
tasks.design: The engineer develops or integrates control feature requirements. Nothing is generated in {DOCS}. Developing and integrating them stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer writes the requirements and fits them together.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the requirement and how it fits stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not integrate a requirement that contradicts one already accepted.
tasks.altitude: The requirements stay the engineer's. Nothing in the work is shortened.

reach.task: Say which requirement their feature needs

evidence.claim: Developing or integrating control feature requirements stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a feature need and ends when the engineer has developed or integrated the requirements, or stops.
No new record is filed by a system. Upkeep is zero.
Implementing the requirement in a control is a different task.
unknowns: Which feature requirements are already accepted and must not be contradicted.
research_questions: Which requirements did the engineer refuse to integrate?

already_counted.description: Developing control feature requirements is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the requirements add no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every requirement is still written by the engineer. High: the same requirements work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Study telemetrics and intelligent transportation systems
Study artificial intelligence or automatic control

tasks.design: The engineer researches computerized automotive applications, such as telemetrics, intelligent transportation systems, artificial intelligence, or automatic control. The engineer reads and judges. Nothing is called in {DATA_PLATFORM}. The research stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer reads the application and judges whether it belongs on the vehicle.
tasks.enabler_now: No external model does the research.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the application stays with the engineer.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not recommend an application they have not understood.
tasks.altitude: The research stays the engineer's reading and judgement. The names are the applications being studied.

reach.learn: Which applications the lead has already rejected.

evidence.claim: Researching these computerized automotive applications stays manual. The engineer does the reading.

assumptions: The work starts with an application to study and ends when the engineer has researched it, or stops.
The words name the applications under study. This task does not call an external model and does not deploy one.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which of these applications are in scope for the vehicle.
research_questions: Which applications did the engineer recommend against, and why?

already_counted.description: Researching computerized automotive applications is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the research adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every application is still studied by the engineer. High: the same research remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Open stored titles of current literature
Attend meetings or conferences with colleagues
Stay abreast of automotive technology and competitive products

tasks.design: The engineer reads current literature, attends meetings or conferences, or talks with colleagues to stay abreast of new automotive technology or competitive products. {DOCS} only opens a stored title list. A missing list stays blank. Reading, attending, and judging the technology stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The engineer found papers, went to the meeting, and judged what mattered.
tasks.enabler_now: A topic can open titles the engineer stored earlier.
tasks.still_hard: Reading and judging the technology stay with the engineer. Attending stays in person.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer does not treat a title list as a summary of the paper.
tasks.altitude: Staying abreast stays the engineer's reading and attendance. The list only opens titles.

reach.learn: Which products that colleague has already assessed.

evidence.claim: A stored topic can open a list of titles. Reading the literature and attending meetings stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a topic and ends when the engineer has read, attended, or judged the technology, or stops.
A title row has topic and title, entered by the engineer. A missing list is left blank.
Opening the list does not shorten the reading or the meeting. The list is not a summary.
unknowns: Which conferences the engineer is expected to attend.
research_questions: How often was the title list blank, so the engineer searched as before?

already_counted.description: Staying abreast of automotive technology is already in the engineer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: opening a title list adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the list is often blank, so the reading is unchanged. High: the titles open, and reading plus attending still take the time. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineer still tests, calibrates, and signs the design. A report, estimate, procedure, or document is written or published only after the engineer accepts that version.
reach: A project lead receives only a status report the engineer has accepted.
A production colleague receives only a procedure the engineer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required figure, milestone, or price is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a publication.
Keep testing, calibration, and design decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every status report traces to a stored milestone, and the engineer still signs the exception.
